senses.gloss:
श्रौत, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the ear or hearing;
relating or belonging to the Veda, prescribed by the
Vedas, founded on the Vedas; sacrificial; (अम्), n.
any observance ordained by the Vedas; preservation
of the sacred fire; the three sacred fires collectively,
(viz. गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय, and दक्षिण); (ई),
f. comparison expressed by a particle (?).
—श्रौत-
कर्मन्, अ, n. a Vedic rite.
—श्रौत-पद्धति, इस्,
f., N. of a work, (probably belonging to the Sāma-
veda.)
—श्रौत-प्रायश्चित्त, अम्, n., N. of a Pari-
śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda.
—श्रौत-श्रव, अस्, m. a
proper N.
—श्रौत-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of certain
Sūtras or Sūtra works based on Śruti or the Veda,
see सूत्र, (ascribed to various authors, such as Āśva-
lāyana, Kātyāyana, Śāṅkhāyana, &c.)
—श्रौत-
स्मार्त-क्रिया, f. any act conformable to law and
the Veda.
—श्रौत-स्मार्त-धर्म, अस्, m. a duty
enjoined by law and the Veda.
—श्रौत-होम-प-
रिशिष्ट, अम्, n. a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda.

श्रौतर्ष, अस्, m. a patronymic from Śrutarṣi,
a son of Śrutarṣi.

श्रौत्र, अम्, n. the ear; that which relates to
the ear or hearing; conversancy with the Vedas.

श्रौषट्, ind. ‘may he, i. e. the god, hear us!’
an exclamation used in making an offering with fire
to the gods or departed spirits; [cf. वौषट्.]

श्रौष्टिन् श्रौष्टिन्, ई, m. (fr. श्रुष्टी = क्षि-
प्र), Ved. having speed, quick, rapid, (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 48, 2. श्रौष्टी = क्षि-
प्र-गाम्य् अश्वः.)

स्रौघ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, of or belonging to the
country of Srughna, coming from Srughna; suited
to Srughna; abounding in Srughna, abiding or staying
in Srughna; going or leading to Srughna, looking
toward Srughna (as a gate &c.); (अस्), m. an inha-
bitant of Srughna; (अम्), n. the gate leading to
Srughna, (Pāṇ. IV. 3, 86.)
